releases.title: w1-rc5: World 1 complete, rising 1-3 lift rideable
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
**w1-rc5**: World 1 (1-1 to 1-4). Built from game-developer `64cdad2a466e670275fbc0bf69b4c9afac1b99d8` plus artist `144b1149ff7aa4cd2bfbd8e88e3572183f399cdd` (the same assets as w1-rc3/rc4), assembled by `ht-role delivery`.

**Start:** unzip `w1-rc5.zip` and double-click `w1-rc5/index.html`. It runs offline from `file://` in Chrome, Firefox or Edge; any static server works too. Press Enter to start. Controls: arrows to move (Down to enter pipes), Z/Shift to run and fire, X/Space to jump, Enter to pause, M to mute.

**New since w1-rc4 (producer #12):**
- **1-3 vertical lift (playtester N4):** Mario now rides the lift while it rises at its full speed (about 1.57 px/frame) instead of sinking through it and dying.
  - The landing test in `src/game.js` `collidePlatforms` now compares Mario's previous feet with the lift's top as it stands, plus the lift's own rise.
  - The 1-2 lifts that wrap from the bottom of the screen to the top are excluded from that allowance.
  - The 1-2 lifts and the three 1-3 horizontal lifts carry Mario as before.
- **Unknown levels:** `index.html#level=9-9`, or any other unknown level, now starts 1-1 instead of leaving a black screen.
- **Level decoder off main:**
  - `tools/smb_levels.py` is no longer on `main`; it is kept on branch `level-decoder`.
  - The README now says the layouts were transcribed from the original level maps, and that `tests/` and `tools/` are developer files not needed to play.

**Checked on this zip** (headless Chromium, run from its own unzipped contents):
- `tests/levels.py`: 27/27. Two checks are new:
  - The vertical lift is landed on in 16 phases from 24 px above, with no input, and ridden for 3 s without ever losing it, through its fastest rise of 1.57 px/frame. On the w1-rc4 landing code, Mario drops through and dies in every phase.
  - The `#level=9-9` fallback check passes.
- `tests/bot.py 1-1`: reaches the flag and goes on to 1-2 with no page errors.
- `tests/sound_input.py`: 7/7.
- On the source with these assets, `mechanics.py` 20/20, `mechanics2.py` 26/26 and `mechanics3.py` 19/19.
- A lift probe on the source with these assets: the 1-2 down lifts are ridden 110/110 frames. The 1-2 up lifts carry Mario until they wrap off the top of the screen, the same as w1-rc4. The 1-3 vertical and horizontal lifts are ridden 112/112 frames each.

**Known gaps:** Worlds 2–8 are not in this round's scope (a warp pipe leads to an end screen saying so).

releases.title: World 1-1 candidate rc1 (real art and audio)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
**Candidate rc1: World 1-1 with the artist's real art and audio.** This is the first playable candidate. It covers P1 only; 1-2 to 1-4 (P2) are not in it.

**Start:** unzip `smb-w1-rc1.zip`, then open `smb-w1-rc1/index.html` (double-click; it runs from `file://`, offline, with no server and no CDN). Alternatively, run `python3 -m http.server` in that folder and open http://localhost:8000/.

**Controls:**
- Arrows (or WASD) move; Down crouches or enters a pipe.
- `Z`/`J`/Shift = B (run, fireball).
- `X`/`K`/Space = A (jump).
- Enter (or `P`) = start / pause.
- `M` = mute.

**Built from:**
- `world/game-developer` `8bbb0325661334ec3511fbb7be27d2d558ec6f27` (index.html, src/)
- `world/artist` `c042385d007674cce5de34db0ebe885e84f6f225` (assets/)
- Assembled with `ht-role delivery` (`tools/package.sh`).

**How it was checked:** headless Chromium 1.64 (Playwright), loading the page from `file://`.
- `tests/mechanics.py`: 20/20 pass.
- `tests/mechanics2.py`: 26/26 pass.
- `tests/bot.py`: completes 1-1 start to flag with keyboard inputs only (no teleports): 0 deaths, about 1956 frames, then the flag, castle and tally run to the end screen.
- With the unzipped package: 0 page errors, 0 console messages, all 30 audio files and every image resolve (`assets/manifest.js`).

**P1 coverage (each item checked as listed):**
- **Layout:**
  - 1-1 tile layout from the original, including the hidden 1-up block, the multi-coin brick (up to 16 coins within about 4 s), and the star brick.
  - The coin-room pipe (Down on the 4th pipe) leading to the underground coin room, and the exit pipe back out near the end.
  - Stairs, flagpole and castle.
  - Checked by tests and the bot run.
- **Physics:**
  - NES momentum constants for walk and run, skidding on direction reversal, three jump-speed tiers, and variable jump height (held 66 px standing, tap about 22 px).
  - Air control limited by take-off speed, and a camera that only moves forward.
  - Checked by tests.
- **Enemies:**
  - Goomba (stomp flattens it).
  - Koopa: stomp turns it into a shell, a kick sends it sliding, and a sliding shell kills enemies with chain scores; the shell wakes after about 5 s.
  - Stomp chains run 100…8000 and then give a 1UP.
  - Enemies turn at walls and at each other (enemy-against-enemy turning has no separate test).
- **Power-ups:**
  - Mushroom (grow), fire flower (fireballs that bounce, at most 2 on screen), star (invincible, starman music), 1-up mushroom.
  - Damage: big or fire Mario shrinks to small with blinking invulnerability; small Mario dies.
  - Big Mario breaks bricks; small Mario bumps them.
- **Coins:** ? blocks and coin tiles give coins; 100 coins give a 1-up and reset the counter to 0 (tested).
- **HUD:** MARIO score, coin counter, WORLD, TIME (400, counting down one unit every 24 frames). HURRY plays at 100 and the music speeds up. Time running out kills Mario and shows the TIME UP screen.
- **Lives and flow:**
  - Lives start at 3.
  - Death jump animation, then the WORLD 1-1 / lives screen; respawn at the start, or at the mid-level checkpoint (column 82) once it is passed. The checkpoint respawn has no separate test yet.
  - Pit death.
  - GAME OVER returns to the title. The title has a TOP score kept in localStorage.
- **Flagpole:** height score (5000/2000/800/400/100), flag slide, Mario turns and walks into the castle, remaining time is counted into score (50 per unit), castle flag. Fireworks play when the timer's last digit is 1, 3 or 6.
- **Audio:**
  - Every SFX and music cue in `docs/assets.md` is wired to its event in `src/`.
  - Recorded firing in the bot run: overworld, jump_small, coin, bump, stomp, flagpole, course_clear and the tally beep.
  - Not yet recorded in an automated run (wired, but playback not logged): powerup_appear, powerup, jump_big, break, kick, pipe, underground, fireball, oneup, starman, hurry, death, game_over, pause.
- **Display:** 256×240 canvas, integer-scaled to the window, pixel-crisp, with a fixed 60 Hz logic step.

**Known limits in rc1:**
- After 1-1 the game shows an end screen ("YOU CLEARED WORLD 1"), because 1-2 to 1-4 come in the next candidates.
- Music loops use `<audio loop>` (the only audio that works from `file://`), so a browser may leave a very short gap at the loop point.
- Only one player (no 2-player mode).
